vsm1.2:35.2: ekāsanikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.
vsm1.2:35.3: Tena pana ekāsanikena āsanasālāyaṃ nisīdantena therāsane anisīditvā
vsm1.2:35.4: ‘‘idaṃ mayhaṃ pāpuṇissatī’’ti patirūpaṃ āsanaṃ sallakkhetvā nisīditabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:35.5: Sacassa vippakate bhojane ācariyo vā upajjhāyo vā āgacchati, uṭṭhāya vattaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:35.6: Tipiṭakacūḷābhayatthero panāha ‘‘āsanaṃ vā rakkheyya bhojanaṃ vā,
vsm1.2:35.7: ayañca vippakatabhojano, tasmā vattaṃ karotu, bhojanaṃ pana mā bhuñjatū’’ti.
vsm1.2:36.2: Tattha ukkaṭṭho appaṃ vā hotu bahu vā, yamhi bhojane hatthaṃ otāreti, tato aññaṃ gaṇhituṃ na labhati.
vsm1.2:36.3: Sacepi manussā ‘‘therena na kiñci bhutta’’nti sappiādīni āharanti,
vsm1.2:36.5: Majjhimo yāva patte bhattaṃ na khīyati,
vsm1.2:36.6: tāva aññaṃ gaṇhituṃ labhati. Ayañhi bhojanapariyantiko nāma hoti.
vsm1.2:36.7: Muduko yāva āsanā na vuṭṭhāti tāva bhuñjituṃ labhati.
vsm1.2:36.8: So hi udakapariyantiko vā hoti yāva pattadhovanaṃ na gaṇhāti tāva bhuñjanato, āsanapariyantiko vā yāva na vuṭṭhāti tāva bhuñjanato.
vsm1.2:36.9: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi nānāsanabhojanaṃ bhuttakkhaṇe dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati. Ayamettha bhedo.
vsm1.2:37.1: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso, appābādhatā, appātaṅkatā, lahuṭṭhānaṃ, balaṃ, phāsuvihāro,
vsm1.2:38.1:
Ekāsanabhojane rataṃ,
Na yatiṃ bhojanapaccayā rujā;
Visahanti rase alolupo,
Parihāpeti na kammamattano.
vsm1.2:38.2:
Iti phāsuvihārakāraṇe,
Sucisallekharatūpasevite;
Janayetha visuddhamānaso,
Ratimekāsanabhojaneti.
vsm1.2:39.2: pattapiṇḍikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.
vsm1.2:39.3: Tena pana pattapiṇḍikena yāgupānakāle bhājane ṭhapetvā byañjane laddhe
vsm1.2:39.4: byañjanaṃ vā paṭhamaṃ khāditabbaṃ, yāgu vā pātabbā.
vsm1.2:39.5: Sace pana yāguyaṃ pakkhipati, pūtimacchakādimhi byañjane pakkhitte yāgu paṭikūlā hoti,
vsm1.2:39.6: appaṭikūlameva ca katvā bhuñjituṃ vaṭṭati. Tasmā tathārūpaṃ byañjanaṃ sandhāya idaṃ vuttaṃ.
vsm1.2:39.8: taṃ pakkhipitabbaṃ. Gaṇhantena ca pamāṇayuttameva gaṇhitabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:39.9: Āmakasākaṃ hatthena gahetvā khādituṃ vaṭṭati. Tathā pana akatvā patteyeva pakkhipitabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:39.10: Dutiyakabhājanassa pana paṭikkhittattā aññaṃ rukkhapaṇṇampi na vaṭṭatīti idamassa vidhānaṃ.
vsm1.2:40.2: Tattha ukkaṭṭhassa aññatra ucchukhādanakālā kacavarampi chaḍḍetuṃ na vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:40.4: Majjhimassa ekena hatthena bhinditvā khādituṃ vaṭṭati, hatthayogī nāmesa.
vsm1.2:40.6: tassa yaṃ sakkā hoti patte pakkhipituṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ hatthena vā dantehi vā bhinditvā khādituṃ vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:40.7: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi dutiyakabhājanaṃ sāditakkhaṇe dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati. Ayamettha bhedo.
vsm1.2:41.2: āhāre payojanamattadassitā, thālakādipariharaṇakhedābhāvo, avikkhittabhojitā, appicchatādīnaṃ anulomavuttitāti.
vsm1.2:42.1:
Nānābhājanavikkhepaṃ, hitvā okkhittalocano;
Khaṇanto viya mūlāni, rasataṇhāya subbato.
vsm1.2:42.2:
Sarūpaṃ viya santuṭṭhiṃ, dhārayanto sumānaso;
Paribhuñjeyya āhāraṃ, ko añño pattapiṇḍikoti.
vsm1.2:43.2: khalupacchābhattikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.
vsm1.2:43.3: Tena pana khalupacchābhattikena pavāretvā puna bhojanaṃ kappiyaṃ kāretvā na bhuñjitabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:44.2: Tattha ukkaṭṭho yasmā paṭhamapiṇḍe pavāraṇā nāma natthi, tasmiṃ pana ajjhohariyamāne aññaṃ paṭikkhipato hoti,
vsm1.2:44.3: tasmā evaṃ pavārito paṭhamapiṇḍaṃ ajjhoharitvā dutiyapiṇḍaṃ na bhuñjati.
vsm1.2:44.4: Majjhimo yasmiṃ bhojane pavārito, tadeva bhuñjati.
vsm1.2:44.5: Muduko pana yāva āsanā na vuṭṭhāti tāva bhuñjati.
vsm1.2:44.6: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi pavāritānaṃ kappiyaṃ kārāpetvā bhuttakkhaṇe dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati. Ayamettha bhedo.
vsm1.2:45.2: nirāmisasannidhitā, puna pariyesanāya abhāvo, appicchatādīnaṃ anulomavuttitāti.
vsm1.2:46.1:
Pariyesanāya khedaṃ, na yāti na karoti sannidhiṃ dhīro;
Odarikattaṃ pajahati, khalupacchābhattiko yogī.
vsm1.2:46.2:
Tasmā sugatapasatthaṃ, santosaguṇādivuḍḍhisañjananaṃ;
Dose vidhunitukāmo, bhajeyya yogī dhutaṅgamidanti.
vsm1.2:47.2: āraññikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.
vsm1.2:48.1: Tena pana āraññikena gāmantasenāsanaṃ pahāya araññe aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:48.3: Gāmo nāma yo koci ekakuṭiko vā anekakuṭiko vā parikkhitto vā aparikkhitto vā samanusso vā amanusso vā antamaso atirekacātumāsaniviṭṭho yo koci satthopi.
vsm1.2:48.4: Gāmūpacāro nāma parikkhittassa gāmassa sace anurādhapurasseva dve indakhīlā honti, abbhantarime indakhīle ṭhitassa thāmamajjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto.
vsm1.2:48.5: Tassa lakkhaṇaṃ yathā taruṇamanussā attano balaṃ dassentā bāhaṃ pasāretvā leḍḍuṃ khipanti, evaṃ khittassa leḍḍussa patanaṭṭhānabbhantaranti vinayadharā.
vsm1.2:48.7: Aparikkhittagāme yaṃ sabbapaccantimassa gharassa dvāre ṭhito mātugāmo bhājanena udakaṃ chaḍḍeti, tassa patanaṭṭhānaṃ gharūpacāro.
vsm1.2:48.8: Tato vuttanayena eko leḍḍupāto gāmo, dutiyo gāmūpacāro.
vsm1.2:49.1: Araññaṃ pana vinayapariyāye tāva ‘‘ṭhapetvā gāmañca gāmūpacārañca sabbametaṃ arañña’’nti (pārā. 92) vuttaṃ.
vsm1.2:49.2: Abhidhammapariyāye ‘‘nikkhamitvā bahi indakhīlā, sabbametaṃ arañña’’nti (vibha. 529) vuttaṃ.
vsm1.2:49.3: Imasmiṃ pana suttantikapariyāye ‘‘āraññakaṃ nāma senāsanaṃ pañcadhanusatikaṃ pacchima’’nti idaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ.
vsm1.2:49.4: Taṃ āropitena ācariyadhanunā parikkhittassa gāmassa indakhīlato aparikkhittassa paṭhamaleḍḍupātato paṭṭhāya yāva vihāraparikkhepā minitvā vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:50.2: yaṃ sabbapaṭhamaṃ senāsanaṃ vā bhattasālā vā dhuvasannipātaṭṭhānaṃ vā bodhi vā cetiyaṃ vā dūre cepi senāsanato hoti, taṃ paricchedaṃ katvā minitabbanti vinayaṭṭhakathāsu vuttaṃ.
vsm1.2:50.3: Majjhimaṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana vihārassapi gāmasseva upacāraṃ nīharitvā ubhinnaṃ leḍḍupātānaṃ antarā minitabbanti vuttaṃ.
vsm1.2:51.1: Sacepi āsanne gāmo hoti, vihāre ṭhitehi mānusakānaṃ saddo suyyati, pabbatanadīādīhi pana antaritattā na sakkā ujuṃ gantuṃ.
vsm1.2:51.2: Yo tassa pakatimaggo hoti, sacepi nāvāya sañcaritabbo, tena maggena pañcadhanusatikaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:51.3: Yo pana āsannagāmassa aṅgasampādanatthaṃ tato tato maggaṃ pidahati,
vsm1.2:52.1: Sace pana āraññikassa bhikkhuno upajjhāyo vā ācariyo vā gilāno hoti,
vsm1.2:52.2: tena araññe sappāyaṃ alabhantena gāmantasenāsanaṃ netvā upaṭṭhātabbo.
vsm1.2:52.3: Kālasseva pana nikkhamitvā aṅgayuttaṭṭhāne aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:52.5: tesaṃyeva kiccaṃ kātabbaṃ. Na dhutaṅgasuddhikena bhavitabbanti idamassa vidhānaṃ.
vsm1.2:53.2: Tattha ukkaṭṭhena sabbakālaṃ araññe aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:53.3: Majjhimo cattāro vassike māse gāmante vasituṃ labhati. Muduko hemantikepi.
vsm1.2:53.4: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi yathā paricchinne kāle araññato āgantvā gāmantasenāsane dhammassavanaṃ suṇantānaṃ aruṇe uṭṭhitepi dhutaṅgaṃ na bhijjati.
vsm1.2:53.5: Sutvā gacchantānaṃ antarāmagge uṭṭhitepi na bhijjati.
vsm1.2:53.6: Sace pana uṭṭhitepi dhammakathike muhuttaṃ nipajjitvā gamissāmāti niddāyantānaṃ aruṇaṃ uṭṭhahati,
vsm1.2:53.7: attano vā ruciyā gāmantasenāsane aruṇaṃ uṭṭhapenti, dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjatīti ayamettha bhedo.
vsm1.2:54.1: Ayaṃpanānisaṃso, āraññiko bhikkhu araññasaññaṃ manasikaronto bhabbo aladdhaṃ vā samādhiṃ paṭiladdhuṃ laddhaṃ vā rakkhituṃ,
vsm1.2:54.3: Yathāha – ‘‘tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārenā’’ti (a. ni. 6.42; 8.86).
vsm1.2:54.4: Pantasenāsanavāsino cassa asappāyarūpādayo cittaṃ na vikkhipanti, vigatasantāso hoti,
vsm1.2:54.5: jīvitanikantiṃ jahati, pavivekasukharasaṃ assādeti, paṃsukūlikādibhāvopi cassa patirūpo hotīti.
vsm1.2:55.1:
Pavivitto asaṃsaṭṭho, pantasenāsane rato;
Ārādhayanto nāthassa, vanavāsena mānasaṃ.
vsm1.2:55.2:
Eko araññe nivasaṃ, yaṃ sukhaṃ labhate yati;
Rasaṃ tassa na vindanti, api devā saindakā.
vsm1.2:55.3:
Paṃsukūlañca esova, kavacaṃ viya dhārayaṃ;
Araññasaṅgāmagato, avasesadhutāyudho.
vsm1.2:55.4:
Samattho nacirasseva, jetuṃ māraṃ savāhiniṃ;
Tasmā araññavāsamhi, ratiṃ kayirātha paṇḍitoti.
